note: WifiOptions CBOR (8.2.2.3 Table 7). Key 3 (Supported Bands, bstr) is always included; key 0 (pass-phrase) never is (both sides derive it). Keys 1 and 2 only when known after NAN picks the channel. The values (Operating Class 81 = 2.4 GHz 20 MHz, Channel 6, Bands 0x02) are our example, not standard values. The Android encoder must produce the same bytes
